title: Evaluating Uncertainty and Quality of Vision-Language-Action-enabled Robots
abstract: arXiv:2507.17049v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)-enabled robots integrate visual perception, natural language understanding, and action planning to interpret their environment, comprehend instructions, and perform embodied tasks autonomously. Such robots are typically evaluated through task success rates, i.e., whether a robot performs its intended task, which are commonly used as test oracles for evaluating such robots. Such an evaluation fails to capture the quality of task execution and the robot's confidence in its decisions. In this paper, we adapt eight uncertainty metrics and five quality metrics specifically designed for VLA-enabled robotic manipulation tasks. We assess their effectiveness through a large-scale empirical study involving 908 successful task executions from three state-of-the-art VLA models across four representative robotic manipulation tasks and two robot embodiments. Human domain experts manually labeled task quality, enabling

translated_title: 评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人的不确定性与质量
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人集成了视觉感知、自然语言理解和动作规划，以解释其所处环境、理解指令并自主执行具身任务。此类机器人通常通过任务成功率来评估，即机器人是否完成其预期任务，任务成功率常被用作评估此类机器人的测试判据。然而，这种评估方式无法捕捉任务执行的质量以及机器人对其决策的置信度。在本文中，我们专门针对VLA机器人操作任务适配了八种不确定性指标和五种质量指标。我们通过一项大规模实证研究来评估这些指标的有效性，该研究涵盖三个最先进的VLA模型在四个代表性机器人操作任务和两种机器人本体上执行的908次成功任务。人类领域专家对任务质量进行了人工标注，从而……
tldr: 该论文针对VLA机器人操作任务适配了八种不确定性指标和五种质量指标，并通过涵盖908次任务执行、三个VLA模型、四个操作任务和两种机器人本体的大规模实证研究验证其有效性，弥补了仅以任务成功率评估机器人而无法反映执行质量与决策置信度的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts eight uncertainty metrics and five quality metrics specifically for VLA-enabled robotic manipulation tasks, and validates their effectiveness through a large-scale empirical study involving 908 successful task executions from three state-of-the-art VLA models, addressing the limitations of evaluating robots solely by task success rates.
